blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `removePriceListPricesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow removes prices. It's used by other workflows, such
as [batchPriceListPricesWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/batchPriceListPricesWorkflow).

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to
remove prices in your custom flows.
